assessment.title: B2B Pricing Execution Maturity Assessment
assessment.subtitle: A focused module of the Configure to WIN Quote Performance Scan

calculation.current_average: Calculate only when both current-state statements in the dimension are answered.
calculation.target_average: Calculate only when both optional target-state statements in the dimension are answered.
calculation.priority_gate: Show priority ranks only when all twelve current-state statements are answered.
calculation.priority_order: Ascending current dimension average, then fixed dimension order.

questions.statement: Current list, cost, floor and currency data is available before quoting begins.
Your team can identify the correct source and version of each commercial value.
Current account- and product-specific price agreements are available inside the quote context.
Deviations from existing customer prices are calculated explicitly.
Discounts, margins, rebates and incentives are calculated consistently.
Sales, pricing and finance use the same commercial calculation logic.
The applicable price is used consistently in each quote.
Manual price overrides remain visible and controlled.
Defined conditions determine when pricing approval is required.
Approval authority and routing are applied consistently.
Source values, calculations, rules and decisions can be reconstructed.
Management can identify recurring pricing exceptions, leakage and control gaps.

maturity_descriptions.Reactive: List, cost, floor and currency values are gathered manually from scattered sources. The correct source and version depend on individual knowledge.
maturity_descriptions.Emerging: Some sources and owners are identified, but teams still use local copies, incomplete records or manual version checks.
maturity_descriptions.Established: Source definitions and update responsibilities are documented and repeatable, but effective dates, freshness or quote-time enforcement remain inconsistent.
maturity_descriptions.Advanced: Governed sources are resolved systematically with ownership, effective dates, currency treatment and traceable selected values.
maturity_descriptions.Intelligent: Source freshness, usage and failures are measured; drift and stale records are reviewed and controls are improved using evidence.

next_controls.Reactive: Assign owners and register the approved list, cost, floor and currency sources used before quoting.
next_controls.Emerging: Document source, version, effective-date and update standards and apply them across the selected quote scope.
next_controls.Established: Enforce source resolution and freshness checks systematically and capture missing or stale-data exceptions.
next_controls.Advanced: Measure source freshness, usage and failure patterns and manage a feedback loop with data owners.
next_controls.Intelligent: Maintain governance, monitor source drift and refine controls using freshness, error and usage evidence.

maturity_descriptions.Reactive: Agreements are stored in emails, spreadsheets or previous quotes and must be found and interpreted manually.
maturity_descriptions.Emerging: Selected agreements are recorded, but coverage, scope, effective dates or use in quoting remain incomplete or locally managed.
maturity_descriptions.Established: Agreement records, scope and validity are documented and used repeatably, but application and deviation control are not consistently enforced.
maturity_descriptions.Advanced: The applicable account- and product-specific price is resolved in the quote context; deviations and overrides are calculated, governed and traceable.
maturity_descriptions.Intelligent: Agreement quality, expiry, deviation and override patterns are reviewed and used to improve maintenance and execution controls.

next_controls.Reactive: Create a controlled register for account- and product-specific agreements, including value, scope, currency and effective dates.
next_controls.Emerging: Document agreement maintenance and quote-time lookup standards and apply them consistently across the selected scope.
next_controls.Established: Resolve applicable agreements systematically and calculate deviations and overrides as controlled exceptions.
next_controls.Advanced: Measure expiry, deviation and override patterns and create a managed feedback loop with agreement owners.
next_controls.Intelligent: Maintain governance, monitor agreement drift and refine maintenance and execution controls using evidence.

maturity_descriptions.Reactive: Discounts, margins, rebates and incentives are calculated in person-owned spreadsheets or with inconsistent definitions.
maturity_descriptions.Emerging: Shared templates or common formulas exist for some quotes, but manual exceptions and competing definitions remain.
maturity_descriptions.Established: Calculation definitions are documented and repeatable, but they are not enforced consistently across teams, quote types or systems.
maturity_descriptions.Advanced: Governed formulas use traceable inputs to calculate discounts, margins, rebates, incentives and other deal measures systematically.
maturity_descriptions.Intelligent: Calculation outcomes, exceptions and formula performance are reconciled and reviewed; definitions are refined through a managed feedback loop.

next_controls.Reactive: Agree ownership and one controlled calculation specification for discounts, margins, rebates and incentives.
next_controls.Emerging: Document calculation definitions, sources and rounding and apply them consistently across the selected quote scope.
next_controls.Established: Enforce governed formulas systematically and capture calculation exceptions and source failures.
next_controls.Advanced: Reconcile calculated and realised outcomes and manage a feedback loop for definitions and assumptions.
next_controls.Intelligent: Maintain formula governance, monitor drift and refine calculation controls using reconciled evidence.

maturity_descriptions.Reactive: The applied price is selected or overridden manually, with limited visibility into why it was used.
maturity_descriptions.Emerging: Pricing guidance exists, but adoption is local and manual overrides are not recorded consistently.
maturity_descriptions.Established: Standard price-selection and override practices are documented and repeatable, but enforcement differs by team or workflow.
maturity_descriptions.Advanced: The applicable price is applied systematically; overrides require defined context and remain visible, controlled and traceable.
maturity_descriptions.Intelligent: Execution accuracy, override patterns and leakage are measured and used to refine price-selection and exception controls.

next_controls.Reactive: Define how the applicable price is selected and the minimum reason and authority evidence for a manual override.
next_controls.Emerging: Document price-selection and override standards and apply them consistently across the selected workflow.
next_controls.Established: Enforce applicable-price resolution and override capture systematically before quote release.
next_controls.Advanced: Measure override frequency, execution accuracy and leakage and manage a feedback loop with control owners.
next_controls.Intelligent: Maintain execution governance, monitor drift and refine price and override controls using evidence.

maturity_descriptions.Reactive: Approval depends on judgement, email and individual availability; triggers and authority are unclear.
maturity_descriptions.Emerging: Some thresholds and roles are defined, but routing and application vary by team, deal or reviewer.
maturity_descriptions.Established: Approval policy, authority and routing are documented and repeatable, but enforcement, evidence or reapproval remains inconsistent.
maturity_descriptions.Advanced: Governed rules apply authority, routing and reapproval systematically and preserve the decision context and outcome.
maturity_descriptions.Intelligent: Approval outcomes, timing, false positives, exceptions and rule drift are measured and used to refine controlled routing.

next_controls.Reactive: Document the minimum pricing triggers, decision authority and evidence required for an approval decision.
next_controls.Emerging: Standardise approval conditions, authority, routing and reapproval rules across the selected quote scope.
next_controls.Established: Enforce approval routing and reapproval systematically and capture rule, reviewer and outcome evidence.
next_controls.Advanced: Measure routing outcomes, delay, false positives and rule drift and manage a controlled feedback loop.
next_controls.Intelligent: Maintain approval governance, monitor policy drift and refine exception rules using decision evidence.

maturity_descriptions.Reactive: Source values, calculations, rules and decisions cannot be reconstructed reliably; reporting is manual and retrospective.
maturity_descriptions.Emerging: Some evidence is retained, but source, calculation, approval and reporting records remain fragmented.
maturity_descriptions.Established: Required evidence and reporting definitions are documented and repeatable, but traces or management views are incomplete.
maturity_descriptions.Advanced: A connected decision trace links inputs, calculations, rules and approvals, while recurring pricing exceptions are visible to management.
maturity_descriptions.Intelligent: Exception, leakage and control-gap trends are monitored; completed improvements and emerging drift are reviewed using evidence.

next_controls.Reactive: Define the minimum source, calculation, rule and decision evidence that must remain reconstructable.
next_controls.Emerging: Document trace and reporting standards and apply them consistently across the selected quote scope.
next_controls.Established: Connect decision evidence systematically and capture recurring pricing exceptions and control gaps.
next_controls.Advanced: Measure exception, leakage and control-gap trends and manage an evidence-led improvement loop.
next_controls.Intelligent: Maintain trace governance, monitor reporting drift and refine controls using completed-action and outcome evidence.

limitations: Results are based only on the answers entered by the user.
The assessment does not provide an industry or market benchmark.
It does not calculate an overall pricing or Quote Performance Score.
It does not compare the organisation with other participants.
It does not assess willingness-to-pay, packaging strategy or market price optimisation.
It does not recommend a product, vendor or implementation architecture.
Target-state gaps are planning inputs, not proof of business impact.
Use of the downloaded workbook does not by itself submit entered data to Configure to WIN.
